decision: Continue owned render-worker integration; no runtime promotion or gameplay FPS claim.
measurement_contract: Own worker and installed DXVK, no external accelerator DLL in any process.
Direct mode performs native pose preparation and drawing serially on the worker, without a palette packet copy.
Serial-copy and two-slot pipeline modes prepare native poses on the producer and copy all palette bytes to owned packets.
All modes consume the same native decoded next endpoints and native matrix-source values.
Eight jobs per sample, alternating regular/extra poses; 21 retained three-mode samples after three warmups, with six mode orderings.
Completion includes all producer work, copies, queue/backpressure waits and GPU drains. Queue and caller times are retained separately.
Each workload is a synthetic regular/extra pair for one pass, not a complete frame. Lit and shadow savings cannot be added or converted to FPS.

validation.full_production_suite: Passed at base commit da85d4e; not repeated for this optional test-only extension.

limits: 43,200 vector decodes per draw with generated channels and controlled warm cursors; count and cursor distribution were not captured from gameplay.
Decoded next endpoints alter actual rendered bone positions; no interpolation, hierarchy composition or real animation assets are modeled.
Warm advances zero and one are sensitivity cases, not a measured distribution of animation work.
Matrix providers, fixed materials, geometry, resources and lifetime are synthetic. Bulk-after-second fixture is not the full installed beta.13 renderer.
No simulation, live engine object handoff, terrain, water reflection, UI, Present, failure/Reset integration or network match runs.
Live source capture, resource/effect ownership, Begin/pass result dependencies and game device/window ownership remain unqualified.
The gameplay target remains unmet; installed beta.13 and INI are unchanged.
